aiStudio.title: AI Studio
aiStudio.lead: Start something that talks to your customers for you: an AI agent, a chatbot or a workflow.
aiStudio.noAccess: You do not have the right to start this one. Ask a workspace admin.

agent.title: AI agent
agent.body: Answers from your own documents and web pages, in your tone.

chatbot.title: Chatbot
chatbot.body: A guided conversation with buttons, questions, cards and files, for your website or WhatsApp.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.body: The advanced canvas: conditions, tags, webhooks and CRM steps that run on their own.

aiStudio.deployNote: Every chatbot has Build, Customize and Deploy tabs. Publish it, then copy its embed code or link from Deploy.
